newsitem.title: UK: Air France Cargo fuel Surcharge from Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: Air France Cargo fuel Surcharge from Nov 4.

text.p: Air France Cargo said it is implementing a 0.50 franc a kg cargo fuel surcharge to all its international and domestic destinations with effect from Monday November 4.
Fuel costs have risen by 40 percent between June and October this year, the French carrier's cargo division said in a statement released here.
It added that between January and September 1996, expenditure on fuel was 125 million francs higher than in same period last year.
"The cargo surcharge will only partially cover the increase in fuel costs since the start of the current year," the statement said.
Air France Cargo operates a fleet of seven Boeing 747 freighters and is due to add an additional 747 freighter in the first quarter of 1997.
